Foldable Theme Band

A theme band that folds like every other section and, folded, still shows the selected theme's chip in its own colors, with where it comes from. Three mockups, five adversarial reviewers, one revised design, an approval round by three more, and the revision they asked for.

1The approved design

What R2 is, rule by rule

    2The three first mockups

    Each wraps the band in the same foldable section the other panels use, starts open and is remembered per panel kind in the plugin's memory, so no setting and no plugin change is involved. They differ in where the fold row sits and how big the folded chip is.

    3Round one: five adversarial reviewers

    Five independent reviewers (visual systems, first-time user, power user, accessibility, adversarial evidence) served the prototypes on the simulated host, tried to break them at four widths, open and folded, by pointer and keyboard, and returned a verdict per variant with required changes and acceptance tests. They are AI agents doing expert inspection, not users.
